opening.argument: The presentation leads with an unusually easy earnings claim: “Sniper Bot for PanCakeswap for free | Earn 1 BNB per day.” It then directs viewers into a funding flow, stating that “we're going to need to put liquidity into this SniperBot” and that the wallet will be taken through Inject Web3. Activation is tied to an action button, after which the bot is said to buy, sell, and bring back BNB. The demonstration displays a contract balance and wallet balance, but does not independently verify the promised returns or who controls transferred funds. The speaker does acknowledge that “It's not going to work every time” and that BNB may not return; those limitations do not remove the combination of an easy wealth claim and required funding.
